alt: Elon Musk's red Tesla Roadster floating in space above Earth with a space-suited mannequin in the driver's seat, photographed from the SpaceX Falcon Heavy payload bay in February 2018
story: Tesla announced its second-generation Roadster in November 2017, collected $250 million in deposits at up to $250,000 per reservation, promised delivery by 2020, and this week set October 1 as the fifth 'reveal event' date of 2026 alone — with production still 12–18 months away from wherever the reveal lands.
why_funny: The original Roadster went to space in 2018; nine years later, deposit-holders are still waiting for the next-gen one to reach their driveway.
